name: openclaw
description: Unofficial, LinuxServer.io-style Docker image for the OpenClaw AI assistant gateway (upstream: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw) - not affiliated with OpenClaw or LinuxServer.io. Uses the PUID/PGID + s6-overlay model so /config is owned by your chosen UID/GID with no manual chown; on Unraid keep PUID=99 / PGID=100 to match appdata ownership. Provide a gateway token and (optionally) an Anthropic API key. The Control UI is served on port 18789. The gateway serves plain HTTP and relies on a front TLS terminator (Tailscale serve or a reverse proxy) for HTTPS - do not expose port 18789 directly to the internet. For a hardened setup set OPENCLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_AUTH=false and OPENCLAW_CONTROL_UI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS to your UI URL, and open the UI via its https URL. amd64 only; image tracks upstream and is rebuilt weekly.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent config, state and workspace (the container's ~/.openclaw lives here)

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns /config. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns /config. Unraid default: 100 (users).

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Umask for files the container creates.

variables.name: OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN
variables.description: Auth token for the gateway. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24

variables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
variables.description: Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...). Leave blank if configured another way.

variables.name: OPENCLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_AUTH
variables.description: Allow the Control UI to authenticate over plain HTTP. Default true for direct LAN-HTTP access. Set false (recommended) when behind a TLS terminator (Tailscale serve / reverse proxy) and open the UI via its https URL.

variables.name: OPENCLAW_CONTROL_UI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated allowed origins for the Control UI (CSRF/origin protection on a non-loopback bind). Set to the URL you reach the UI from, e.g. https://openclaw.YOUR-TAILNET.ts.net. Strongly recommended.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional. OpenAI API key, if using OpenAI models.

variables.name: COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional. GitHub token for Copilot models.

variables.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional. Discord bot token for the Discord channel.

variables.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional. Telegram bot token for the Telegram channel.

variables.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional. Brave Search API key for web search.
